description: Indulge in the viral sensation of Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread, a delightful fusion of sweet and savory flavors. Soft, pillowy bread is generously filled with a luscious cream cheese mixture and then dipped in a fragrant garlic butter sauce. Baked to golden perfection, it offers an irresistible aroma and a taste that will transport you straight to the bustling streets of Seoul.

instructions.title: Prepare the Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, 50g granulated sugar, and 30ml heavy cream. Mix well with a whisk or spatula until the mixture is smooth and creamy with no lumps. Transfer the cream cheese filling into a piping bag or a ziploc bag with a corner snipped off.

instructions.title: Prepare the Garlic Butter Glaze
instructions.text: In another bowl, melt 100g of unsalted butter. Add the finely minced garlic, 30g granulated sugar, one large egg, and 50ml milk. Whisk thoroughly until all ingredients are well combined and the mixture is emulsified. Stir in the finely chopped fresh parsley.

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread Buns
instructions.text: Take each soft round bread bun and make 6-8 deep cuts, slicing almost all the way through but leaving the bottom intact to keep the bun together. These cuts will create pockets for the cream cheese filling.

instructions.title: Fill the Bread Buns
instructions.text: Carefully open the cuts in each bun and pipe or spoon the cream cheese filling generously into each crevice. Ensure the filling is evenly distributed throughout the bun.

instructions.title: Dip and Coat the Buns
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 180C (350F). One by one, gently pick up each filled bun and fully immerse it into the garlic butter glaze. Make sure the entire bun, including the top and sides, is thoroughly coated. Allow any excess glaze to drip off before placing the bun on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

instructions.title: Bake to Golden Perfection
instructions.text: Bake the prepared cream cheese garlic bread in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the cream cheese filling is slightly puffed and warm. Serve immediately while warm for the best taste and texture.

tips: Ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature before mixing to achieve a perfectly smooth and lump-free filling.
For an extra garlicky kick, you can slightly increase the amount of minced garlic in the glaze. Adjust sugar to your preference for a sweeter or more savory profile.
Serve the Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread warm, straight from the oven, as this is when the flavors and textures are at their absolute best.
